'''Variety Theater''' was located in the boom-town settlement of [[Roaring Crater]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. A [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] during the day, the Variety Theater became an entertainment venue in the evening featuring live entertainment and [[Holodrama/Legends|holo-movies]].<ref name="J15" />
